name: Makenshi Kumiko
source:
A part of "Sexy voice" series.

Kumiko was indulged in self-satisfaction when she was warped to the island 's ruins where she was attacked by a monster - an incarnation of her ancient enemy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“Sexy Voice”系列作品之一。

久美子正沉浸于自慰的快感时，突然被传送到一座岛屿的遗迹，并遭到怪物袭击。那头怪物正是她远古宿敌的化身。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
